scope: Standalone conflict-editor command, authorization/adoption and connected shared text/image/delete/submodule routing, captured preferences, exact identities, draft reuse and cancellation ownership.
implementation: Source conflicteditor entry accepts one literal path and optional alternative; path-file validation precedes explicit deletion. CLI normal/alternative choice overrides ambient modifier state.

Captured window/preferences survive private/saved scope acquisition, metadata preparation and root discovery; initialized conflicted submodules use the existing superproject resolver. Workspace adoption receives the validated root separately from the original selected item; accepted extra grants are retained and persisted for an existing saved record.

Shared routing captures merge-tool settings and conflict identities before asynchronous reads. Text, image, delete/modify and submodule native editors receive the owning preferences; default external launch receives captured settings/identities.

Preparation and Delete/Submodule maps now use exact Git path keys, joining existing Text/Image maps. Close callbacks remove only their own controller. Repeated native text entry retains the edited result.

Command/shared preparations participate in pending-work ownership before task execution and until actual drain. Closed/retired owners cancel and fence late routing/error delivery; metadata Git children are reaped.

core.command: GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=0 TURTLEGIT_CORE_ONLY=1 swift test --filter 'PrimaryCommandInvocationTests|ConflictPathIdentityTests|GitPathIdentityTests|RepositoryAccessTests'

build.command: xcodebuild -quiet -project TurtleGitMac.xcodeproj -scheme TurtleGitMac -configuration Debug -destination 'platform=macOS' -derivedDataPath build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build

attempts.failure: Persistence catch assigned to the caught Error rather than self.error.
